name: Ignition by redstone, fire, flint and steel, fire charges, burning projectiles and explosions
note: Redstone: a signal from any neighbor when TNT is placed, moved in by a piston or updated (blocks, levers, diodes, observers, dust, strongly powered blocks); explosions prime TNT with a fuse of 10 to 29 ticks; fire burning it primes it; a burning arrow primes the TNT it hits; dispensers prime TNT items; flint and steel and fire charges a player uses on TNT prime it, and so does flint and steel in a dispenser
deviations: fire charges from dispensers (small fireballs) are not modeled; of the burning projectiles only arrows are modeled
